personalities.name: You're a Curator
personalities.description: You're obsessed with taste. The perfect detail, hidden gem, beautiful space, or beautifully made thing can stop you in your tracks. You don't just notice what's good—you know why it's good.

personalities.name: You're an Explorer
personalities.description: You're obsessed with what's next. New places, ideas, trends, flavors, and experiences keep you curious. Your happy place is somewhere between ‘I've never tried this’ and ‘I need to know more.’

personalities.name: You're a Connector
personalities.description: You're obsessed with people and shared experiences. A great plan is only as good as the people around you, and you have a talent for turning a moment into a memory.

personalities.name: You're an Optimizer
personalities.description: You're obsessed with getting it just right. You spot the better way, the missing detail, and the little upgrade everyone else overlooked. Good is nice. Great is the goal.
